description:
Offered to the market on London Road, this substantial property presents an exciting investment and redevelopment opportunity, occupying a generous plot of approximately one-third of an acre.

The property was previously operated as a veterinary establishment under E Class use and, more recently, as a Christian school under F1 use. Arranged over three floors, the accommodation extends to just over 5,600 sq ft.

The property currently incorporates two residential apartments, comprising one two-bedroom apartment and one three-bedroom apartment, which together provide a current rental income of approximately £35,000 per annum.

With its substantial floor area, existing residential accommodation and generous plot, we believe the property offers significant potential for residential redevelopment, subject to the necessary planning consents, or alternatively continued use for commercial purposes.

This represents an excellent opportunity for investors, developers or owner-occupiers seeking a versatile property with considerable potential. EPC C

Local Information
Reading University is rich in history and boasts some of the most beautiful roads and conservation areas. It’s vibrant and prestigious location with a large green campus for everyone to enjoy. There is a good variety of independent cafes, pubs and shops in the area. The area offers easy access to both the M4 and A329M motorways and offers some of Reading’s top schools such as Reading Boys' Grammar School, Kendrick Girls' Grammar School and The Abbey School. Nearby there is Reading College, the Royal Berkshire Hospital, Reading Bowls Club, shops, gardens, parks, and Palmer Park sports facilities.

Accommodation
The property is set over three floors and extends to over 5,600 sqft and comprises of commercial; F1 Class space and two self contained aparmtents.

Outside Space
The property benefits from multiple parking spaces to the front, with vehicular access to the side providing access to the rear. The rear garden comprises both lawn and paved areas, with the overall plot extending to approximately 0.35 of an acre.

Additional Information
Water, mains drainage, gas and electric connected
